title: How the PSL changed the T20 calendar for Pakistan fans
dek: A league explainer, not a match report. No invented table positions.
author: SceneBuzz Editorial Team
caption: Editorial still life produced for SceneBuzz. Not a news photograph of a specific event.
body: The Pakistan Super League sits in the global T20 window as a home tournament for Pakistan players and a destination for overseas professionals.
SceneBuzz treats the PSL as its own destination — news, teams and season architecture — rather than a footnote on the cricket home.
Fixtures, results and points stay empty until an official feed is connected. Franchises, drafts and overseas signings should be confirmed against PCB and league announcements.

title: Why Test cricket still structures the sport
dek: A format primer for readers who meet cricket first through T20 leagues.
author: SceneBuzz Editorial Team
caption: Editorial still life produced for SceneBuzz. Not a news photograph of a specific event.
body: Test cricket remains the longest examination in the international game: five days, two innings, and a ball that changes behaviour as it ages.
For SceneBuzz readers in Pakistan and the diaspora, Tests are also a calendar — a way of following Pakistan, then India and others, through a season rather than a night.
This explainer does not rank teams or invent a result. It describes why the format still sits underneath white-ball cricket.
